slides_note: The slideshow photographs, in tools/speaker/slides/. They are shown whole (never cropped). Alt text describes only what is visible and names the speaker only where he is the one person pictured. TO ADD A PHOTOGRAPH: copy the file into tools/speaker/slides/ (JPEG, about 1600 px on the long side, under 300 KB), add one entry below with a plain description in alt, then run python3 tools/build.py. Fill in source and rights for every new photograph (who took it, or where it came from, and the permission to use it); the build refuses an entry without them. Reorder by moving entries.
